reason: A browser-side visual customization plugin that replaces the DeepSeek Harness Web primary send button icon with a whale logo without changing send behavior.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness Web 对话输入栏的主发送按钮图标替换为随主题颜色变化的鲸鱼标志。
summaries.en: Replaces the DeepSeek Harness Web chat composer’s primary send button icon with a whale logo that adapts to the current theme color.

capabilities: Injects browser-side CSS into the document head
Replaces the primary send button icon appearance
Preserves the existing send and stop button behavior
